description: The 'Living in <town>' profile for any of Puerto Rico's 78 municipios — housing (median rent, home value, household and per-capita income, ownership, vacancy, poverty, typical build year), work (mean commute, remote-work and transit shares, unemployment, broadband), people (population, density, median age, degrees), mapped services (schools, supermarkets, parks, restaurants, bus stops, beaches per 10,000 residents), the town's AAA water-rationing zones and plan state, and the reported violent-crime rate. Every figure carries the island median and the town's rank among municipios that report it, with sources and vintages (Census ACS 5-Year, OpenStreetMap, PRPD, AAA). Omit `town` for a compact index of all 78.

town.description: Municipio name or slug (e.g. 'Cayey' or 'san-juan'); omit for a compact all-towns index

name: get_town_living
